for lo,hi in [(2,2.7),(2.7,3.4),(3.4,4.1),(4.1,4.8),(4.8,6.1)]:
    m=(T>=lo)&(T<hi)
    if m.sum()<8: continue
    A=np.c_[np.ones(m.sum()),np.log(eps[m]),eps[m],eps[m]**2]
    c,res,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma[m],rcond=None)
    r=sigma[m]-A@c
    print(lo,hi,m.sum(),np.round(c,3),np.std(r).round(4))
